steps.name: exact_duplicate_rows
steps.reason: Verbatim copies of an existing row (all 28 columns identical), incl. the doubled terminal default rows of ids 37067/37130/37792; dropped copies are duplicates of retained rows, so no information is lost.

steps.name: id_collision_loans
steps.reason: 5 ids each contain two interleaved distinct loans (same-(id,time) rows with conflicting covariates, e.g. two different balance_orig/FICO tracks under id 3014, both defaulting); rows cannot be attributed to either loan, so the whole id is excluded.

steps.name: same_quarter_status_conflict
steps.reason: Same-(id,time) pairs identical on every covariate but with one status-0 row shadowing a terminal row (e.g. id 37528 at t=51): the terminal row is kept so the event is preserved; the shadow is dropped.

steps.name: post_terminal_truncation
steps.reason: Generic guard: any row after a loan's FIRST terminal event (default or payoff) is truncated — a loan leaves the at-risk set at its event. Expected 0 after steps 1-3 resolved the 4-loan anomaly; recorded to prove the check ran.

steps.name: nonpositive_origination_balance_loans
steps.reason: 18 loans with balance_orig_time missing-coded as 0 (a static origination defect): original property value = balance_orig / (LTV_orig/100) = 0, so updated LTV and the double-trigger interaction are incomputable for every row of the loan; these are exactly the rows where the vendor's own LTV_time is NaN.

steps.name: zero_balance_live_rows
steps.reason: Non-terminal (status 0) rows with balance_time <= 0: zero exposure on a live row is a missing-coded balance, not a real state — the history continues or the loan is censored at the prior quarter. Terminal payoff rows with balance 0 are KEPT (the zero balance IS the payoff; the row carries the competing-risk event).

steps.name: nonpositive_current_note_rate_rows
steps.reason: Rows with interest_rate_time missing-coded as 0: the prepayment incentive (note rate - market rate) is incomputable; all such rows are status 0, so no events are lost.

state_orig_time_missing.disposition: kept — state unused at this rung (national macros only; no state-level merge in scope)

orig_rate_missing_coded_zero.disposition: kept + flag orig_rate_missing — origination-rate snapshot missing-coded 0; current note rate is populated and drives the prepayment incentive

lag_warmup_rows_time_le_5.disposition: kept + flag lag_warmup — uer_chg4_lag1 needs uer(t-5), undefined before t=6; excluded from no-NaN guarantee

within_loan_time_gaps.disposition: kept — non-consecutive quarter steps inside loans; macro lags repaired from the panel-internal time map so lag distance is always exact
